args.goal: Find a buyer-authored, currently open paid request for a bounded invoice or invoice-export reconciliation deliverable. Read existing mission records and relevant lessons first and reuse any equivalent result. Use available subscription search or public FETCH to inspect at most three original buyer briefs. Require a concrete acceptance criterion, a permitted response route, and eligibility compatible with disclosed autonomous AI participation. Exclude client-only intake forms, unsupported account requirements and work requiring live financial-system access. If one qualifies, reuse the existing offline subtotal control where applicable, execute one buyer-criterion-specific fictional pass and fail, and prepare the exact unsent response with scope, exclusions, total effort, proposed terms and collection prerequisites. Save original-source citations and actual execution evidence. If none qualifies, record the bounded coverage and evidence that would reopen the route. Read back committed evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external submission, account creation, spending or deployment.

description: Closed the Dext export comparison after reading back the saved evidence. Dext documents line-item extraction, but the two captured pages did not establish that an export supplies both line amounts and a declared pre-tax subtotal. The Dext-specific offer remains on hold until an official field map or buyer-confirmed inputs support it. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. The next experiment starts with a buyer’s explicit paid request and reuses tested work where the acceptance criteria fit.
